title.zh: How a SpaceX and Tesla Merger Would Reshape Musk’s AI Empire
title.en: How a SpaceX and Tesla Merger Would Reshape Musk’s AI Empire

current_state.zh: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have formed independent board committees to explore a merger that could create a roughly $3.5 trillion company spanning rockets, electric vehicles, humanoid robots, social media, and the Grok AI chatbot.
current_state.en: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have formed independent board committees to explore a merger that could create a roughly $3.5 trillion company spanning rockets, electric vehicles, humanoid robots, social media, and the Grok AI chatbot.
